acceptedAnswer.text: This page presents a TONTON customer-project reference carrying the artwork shown in the supplied photograph. It does not claim an official retail release, exclusive partnership or governing-body approval.

mainEntity.name: What are the fabric composition and weight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber percentages and GSM are confirmed against the approved material specification for your project. Request a swatch and fit sample before bulk production.

mainEntity.name: How should I check the printing and seams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Review a printed sample for map-line clarity, panel alignment, color and appearance under stretch. The construction brief specifies four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching; confirm stitch construction and the skin-side finish on the physical sample.
